svg.title: Manufacturing recipe and routing records
svg.desc: Manufacturing recipe and routing records. An item links to its bill of material and routing. Routing operations identify work centers, whose calendars provide daily capacity. Keep the record grains separate. Foreign-key paths, analytical matches, and business context answer different questions; read the numbered evidence table before joining.
